HackWave 3.0

Organised by Echelon Dev Society, Chameli Devi Group of Institutions (CDGI)

HackWave 3.0 is CDGI’s annual 36-hour offline hackathon, bringing together student developers, innovators, and tech enthusiasts from across India to build innovative solutions, solve real-world problems, and compete for a total prize pool of ₹1,00,000.

Date: 10th – 12th October 2026
Venue: Chameli Devi Group of Institutions, Indore
Prize Pool: ₹1,00,000
Team Size: 3–5 Members
Mode: Offline
Shortlisted Teams: Top 50 Teams

Who Can Participate?

  • Open to college students across India.
  • Teams must consist of 3–5 members.
  • Both inter-college and inter-specialization teams are allowed.
  • All participants must carry a valid college ID.
  • Participants below 18 years of age must provide parental consent.
  • Participants must bring their own laptops, chargers, and other required equipment.
  • Internet access and basic amenities will be provided at the venue.

Hackathon Format

HackWave 3.0 will be conducted in two rounds.

Round 1: Online PPT Submission

The first round is completely free.

Teams are required to submit a PPT showcasing either:

  • An existing project, or
  • A new project idea

The PPT should include:

  • Team Introduction
  • Project/Idea Overview
  • Key Features
  • Tech Stack
  • Screenshots or Demo Link, if available
  • GitHub Profile/Repository
  • LinkedIn Profiles of Team Members

The submission will be screened based on the team's technical ability, creativity, and problem-solving approach.

After the screening process, the Top 50 teams will be shortlisted for the final round.

Round 2: 36-Hour Offline Hackathon

The shortlisted teams will participate in the final 36-hour offline hackathon at Chameli Devi Group of Institutions, Indore.

How it works:

  • Problem Statements will be revealed at the beginning of the hackathon.
  • Teams will be given the opportunity to select and prioritize their preferred Problem Statements.
  • Based on the selection process, a Problem Statement will be assigned to each team.
  • Teams will then have 36 hours to build their solution from scratch.
  • The final hackathon will be conducted completely offline.
  • Shortlisted teams are required to remain present at the venue for the entire duration of the hackathon.

Final Round Registration Fee

The Round 1 submission is completely free.

Only teams shortlisted for the final round will be required to pay:

₹500 per team

The payment will be used to confirm participation in the final offline round.

Payment instructions will be shared with the shortlisted teams after the Round 1 screening process.

Prize Pool

  • 1st Prize — ₹50,000
  • 2nd Prize — ₹25,000
  • 3rd Prize — ₹15,000
  • 4th Prize — ₹10,000
  • Total Prize Pool — ₹1,00,000

Rules & Regulations

  • All final submissions must be original work created during the final hackathon.
  • The project submitted during Round 1 is only for screening purposes and cannot simply be reused as the final submission.
  • Teams are allowed to use open-source libraries, tools, frameworks, and APIs.
  • Plagiarism, unauthorized code copying, or submission of someone else's work will result in disqualification.
  • Participants must follow all instructions provided by the organizers, mentors, and judges.
  • Participants are expected to maintain professional conduct throughout the event.
  • The decisions of the organizing team and judges will be final and binding.

Why Participate in HackWave 3.0?

  • Compete for a ₹1,00,000 prize pool
  • Build solutions during a 36-hour offline hackathon
  • Work on challenging Problem Statements
  • Collaborate with developers and innovators from across India
  • Challenge your technical and problem-solving skills
  • Connect with a growing community of student developers
  • Get an opportunity to showcase your skills and ideas

Join the official WhatsApp group for updates: https://chat.whatsapp.com/IQdGCPZWAkIDucNrypfvr7?mode=gi_t

Official Website- Hackwave.live

Thank you. Feel free to reach out if you have any doubts:)
